Create a radar plot

Source: R/plot_radar.R
plot_radar.Rd

Create a radar plot of mutation frequencies or other metrics across categories (labels), optionally grouped or faceted by a categorical variable.

Usage

plot_radar(
  mf_data,
  response_col,
  label_col,
  group_col = NULL,
  facet = TRUE,
  label_order = "none",
  label_order_input = NULL,
  group_order = "none",
  group_order_input = NULL,
  custom_palette = NULL,
  label_colors = NULL,
  indiv_y = TRUE,
  plot_legend = TRUE,
  legend_pos = "topright",
  vlcex = 1.2,
  plot_title = NULL,
  facet_col = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

mf_data

A data frame with the data to plot.

response_col

The column with the response values (numeric).

label_col

The column with the labels for the radar plot axes.

group_col

The column with the group variable to plot or facet across. Default is NULL.

facet

A logical indicating whether to create separate faceted plots for each group in group_col (TRUE, default) or plot all groups on a single radar plot (FALSE).

label_order

The ordering method for the axis labels. Options are:

  • "none": Default. Uses existing factor levels if label_col is a factor, or alphabetical order.

  • "arranged": Orders labels based on one or more columns in mf_data specified by label_order_input.

  • "custom": Orders labels based on a custom character vector supplied to label_order_input.

label_order_input

Specifies details for label_order. If label_order = "arranged", a character vector of column name(s) in mf_data used to arrange the data. If label_order = "custom", a character vector of label values in the desired order.

group_order

The ordering method for the groups. Adjusts the facet order when facet = TRUE or the overlay/series order when facet = FALSE. Options are:

  • "none": Default. Uses existing factor levels if group_col is a factor, or the order of appearance in mf_data.

  • "arranged": Orders groups based on one or more columns in mf_data specified by group_order_input.

  • "custom": Orders groups based on a custom character vector supplied to group_order_input.

group_order_input

Specifies details for group_order. If group_order = "arranged", a character vector of column name(s) in mf_data used to arrange the data. If group_order = "custom", a character vector of group values in the desired order.

custom_palette

A custom color palette to distinguish groups. Can be a named character vector of colors (with names corresponding to levels/values in group_col), an unnamed vector of colors, or the name of an RColorBrewer palette. Default is NULL.

label_colors

A custom color specification for the radar axis labels. Can be a named vector of colors (with names corresponding to values in label_col), an unnamed character vector of colors matching the order of labels, or a single color string. Any labels not specified in a named vector default to "black". Default is NULL ("black").

indiv_y

A logical indicating whether to use individual y-axis scales for each plot when facet = TRUE. When facet = FALSE, all groups share the same scale. Default is TRUE.

plot_legend

A logical indicating whether to show a legend when multiple groups are plotted on the same radar chart (facet = FALSE). Default is TRUE.

legend_pos

The position of the legend when plot_legend = TRUE. Can be a keyword such as "topright", "topleft", "bottomright", "bottomleft", etc. Default is "topright".

vlcex

A numeric value specifying character expansion for variable labels. Default is 1.2.

plot_title

An optional title for the plot. If NULL, a default title is generated.

facet_col

Deprecated. Use group_col instead.

...

Additional arguments passed to fmsb::radarchart.

Value

Invisible NULL (generates a base R graphics plot)

Examples

# Plot the MFmin for each variation type, including the 6 SNV subtypes
# Facet the plots by dose group
mf_ex <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "Example_files", "mf_data_6.rds",
     package = "MutSeqR")
)
plot_radar(
     mf_data = mf_ex,
     response_col = "mf_min",
     label_col = "normalized_subtype",
     group_col = "dose_group",
     facet = TRUE,
     indiv_y = TRUE
)


# Plot all groups on the same plot with custom palette and label colors
plot_radar(
     mf_data = mf_ex,
     response_col = "mf_min",
     label_col = "normalized_subtype",
     group_col = "dose_group",
     facet = FALSE,
     custom_palette = c("Control" = "#45567f", "Low" = "#6a74a7",
                        "Medium" = "#c3c9e9", "High" = "#e2aab9"),
     label_colors = c("C>A" = "red", "C>T" = "blue")
)
